name_zh: 内塔尼亚胡/以色列/右翼/定居点/伊朗/亚伯拉罕/司法/长任
description_zh: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡 (1949-) 是以色列政治家，曾任总理。他领导以色列推行右翼政策，包括定居点扩张和伊朗核威胁应对，推动亚伯拉罕协议，实现司法改革，并长期执政。
description_en: Benjamin Netanyahu (1949-) is an Israeli politician who served as Prime Minister. He led Israel to implement right-wing policies including settlement expansion and Iran nuclear threat response, promoted Abraham Accord, realized judicial reform, and long-term governance.
reason_zh: 核心思维：M538(右翼长治/定居点扩张/伊朗威胁/亚伯拉罕协议/司法改革)、1(战略预判)、20(博弈论)、40(三衙分兵/军政分离)、67(战略敏捷)。内塔尼亚胡体现了战略预判和博弈论精神，通过右翼政策和定居点扩张实现国家建设，通过亚伯拉罕协议实现区域合作，通过司法改革实现国家治理。
reason_en: Core thinking modes: M538(Right-Wing Long-Term/Settlement Expansion/Iran Threat/Abraham Accord/Judicial Reform)、1(Strategic Foresight)、20(Game Theory)、40(Three-gate Separation/Military-Civilian Separation)、67(Strategic Agility)。Netanyahu embodies strategic foresight and game theory spirit through right-wing policies and settlement expansion realizing national construction, Abraham Accord realizing regional cooperation, judicial reform realizing national governance.

第3步：三衙分兵法——军政分离：通过司法改革实现国家治理
第4步：战略敏捷法——灵活外交：通过亚伯拉罕协议实现区域合作
